name: MS 365
description: Outlook mail, Calendar, OneDrive, Teams, Excel, To Do, and Contacts — all of Microsoft 365 in one server (~50 tools) via the Microsoft Graph API. Bundled local stdio MCP — ships with the Vodou install.

setupSteps.title: Run the device-code login flow
setupSteps.instructions:
In a terminal, from your Vodou install root, run:
node MCP-servers/ms365/auth.js
A short URL and 8-character code will print. Open the URL in any browser, paste the code, sign in with the Microsoft 365 account you want Vodou to use. Tokens cache locally — auto-refresh from then on.
setupSteps.gotcha: No Azure app registration needed — the package ships with a default multi-tenant client. If your tenant requires a custom app, set MS365_MCP_CLIENT_ID and MS365_MCP_TENANT_ID in your .env before running auth.

setupSteps.title: Add server
setupSteps.instructions: Click Add server below. Vodou runs the bundled launcher with your cached tokens.
setupSteps.gotcha: If you see a No tokens found or auth error, you skipped the login step above — re-run node MCP-servers/ms365/auth.js first.

setupSteps.title: Enable in Tools
setupSteps.instructions: Open Capabilities → MCP Servers and turn ms365 on. You'll get tools across Outlook (mail), Calendar, OneDrive, Teams, Excel, To Do, and Contacts. Try saying 'check my Outlook inbox' or 'show me today's Teams meetings' in chat.
